_comment: Copy to dev/modules/<ID>/module.json and edit. Declares which containers `dev.py up <ID>` starts. Declare ONLY what the module needs: a module with no asynchronous work must not start a broker, so that several standalone stacks can run at once.

_resource_notes.postgres: Required for every module. Real migrations, isolated database.
_resource_notes.frontend: Vite dev server serving this module's React feature routes.
_resource_notes.broker: Only if the module owns asynchronous work.
_resource_notes.worker: Implies broker. Required to assert crash/retry behaviour; eager mode must never be used to claim those results.
_resource_notes.object_storage: S3-compatible private storage, for modules handling files or evidence.
